title: Social media and marketing
description: A project = a campaign or a platform; a content plan in the calendar; posts per platform, ads, A/B headlines, replies to comments, a plan for the week.
folderHint: A folder where every subfolder is a campaign; content-plan.md can live here too

commands.title: Posts per platform
commands.task: From the source material, write a post for each platform: {platform}. Respect their format: length, style, hashtags, emoji, links, call to action. Each post stands on its own, not a copy of the others. For visual platforms — a short idea for the picture or video.

commands.title: Ad variants
commands.task: Suggest 5 ad texts for {platform}: headline, main text, call to action. Different approaches: the customer's pain, the benefit, a review/proof, urgency without pressure, a comparison. No claims that cannot be backed up. Mark which pairs are worth comparing in an A/B test.

commands.title: A/B headlines
commands.task: Suggest 8 pairs of headlines for an A/B test: each pair changes exactly one thing (length, a number, question/statement, emotion, specificity). For each pair — what exactly is being tested.

commands.title: Replies to comments
commands.task: From the material and the audience's typical questions, prepare reply templates for 10 frequent comments: a price question, doubt, a complaint, thanks, a «how» question, trolling, a discount request and so on. Tone: {text}. Short, human replies, no template «Thank you for your feedback!».

commands.title: Content plan for the week
commands.task: Draft a content plan for the week starting {text}: 1–2 posts a day for {platform}. Alternate formats (useful, engaging, selling, behind the scenes). Give a Markdown table in the content plan format — | Date | Time | Platform | Topic | Status | File | — with the status «idea», so the rows can be moved to content-plan.md.

commands.title: Prepare posts from the plan
commands.task: For the content plan entries (content-plan.md) of the next 7 days with the status «idea», write the post texts — each under its own heading with the date and topic. Do not change the content plan itself.
